author: lvpcfix
text: A flaw in SonicOS (CVE-2026-19868) allows attackers to bypass MFA and SAML. It is being actively exploited in the wild right now. Patch immediately.

author: _MadalinDumitru
text: SonicWall SSLVPN vulnerability actively exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-19868 allows attackers with valid alternate credentials to bypass SAML authentication and MFA on SonicOS SSLVPN. Affected Gen7 <= 7.3.3-7015 & Gen8 <= 8.2.2-8015; patched in 7.3.4-7013+.

author: DecryptionDigst
text: SonicWall SSLVPN is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-19868 bypasses both SAML and MFA on Gen7/Gen8 firewalls. CISA added to KEV Nov 6. Federal patch deadline: Nov 20. No workarounds. Patch now.

author: qhxdigital
text: CISA says a WordPress core update flaw (CVE-2026-119977) is being actively exploited. Fix: update to WordPress 7.1.4 or your branch's latest security release.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Some WordPress websites open to attack even while using update to fix actively exploited flaw CVE-2026-119977.

author: 0daywatch
text: Drupal's security team says Commerce Core CVE-2026-118539 is being actively exploited. Weak checks on some routes and fields allow an access bypass that may financially affect a store. Upgrade to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41.

author: fugedizs
text: CISA KEV update: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 is actively exploited and may allow SAML/MFA bypass. Recent KEV entries also impact GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, WordPress and PHP.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-48356 in Adobe Commerce and Magento (unrestricted file upload). On CISA's KEV list since 2026-10-27.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: Zyxel GS1900 switches have a pre-auth RCE flaw, CVE-2026-107441, exploited in the wild and missed by the June patch, fixed October 22.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flags an actively exploited Apple flaw reportedly linked to Russian cyberespionage. Despite its 5.5 severity score, experts urge patching and checks for compromise.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: WordPress Core: active exploitation confirmed. Upgrade to 7.1.4 and temporarily restrict web server access to wp-content/upgrade/ during updates.

author: hifyai
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) is exploited in the wild. On RHEL 9 check for package 8.0.30-8.el9_8.1. Upstream fixes: 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12.

author: Hartdrawss
text: November in 7 days: Node.js servers actively exploited, Chainalysis hacked, Chainstack production systems breached, DreamHost FTP logins stolen, mSecure password manager hacked, cPGuard update server shipped backdoors.

author: cesteban
text: Chainalysis, the blockchain-tracing platform used by law enforcement and banks, says an external actor using "offensive agentic techniques" got into its systems and internal tools; credentials exposed.

author: RoundtableSpace
text: Microsoft warned that attackers are using AI agent tools to scan public GitHub repos for secrets: cloud keys and AI service keys. It's been running since August.

author: yunchanyq6
text: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies of Claude Code's settings.local.json holding real secrets. 'Don't ask again' can save the full command, keys included. Rotate keys first.

author: step_security
text: @ethersphere/bee-js version 13.3.0 on npm is compromised. Malicious code executes during installation, targeting Swarm Desktop. Reported as malicious to npm.

author: 0xF390
text: LiteLLM-style supply chain attack: compromised release of Swarm's official JavaScript SDK @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0.

author: ghostofRoc
text: Beget, Russia's biggest .RU hosting provider, said its entire cloud infrastructure was wiped in a cyberattack on the night of Nov 1-2; attackers got into the cloud control plane.

author: SOCMinute
text: Iris Ohyama disclosed a breach on their third-party cloud platform, exposing personal data of 7.7 million customers.

author: Codezero_io
text: 2.5 million records in last week's Sony So-net breach, including working email credentials for 54,401 accounts.

author: S2W_DailyThreat
text: Actor claims to sell 91APP (Taiwan e-commerce cloud provider) and POYA customer order data, ~2.4M records.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: SEGA confirms 2,196,044 email addresses exposed in breach involving third-party email provider Arara Message.

author: macropaperr
text: Nearly EUR100 million stolen from Credit Mutuel Arkea through fraudulent transfers involving an outside provider.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-19868: SSLVPN Authentication Enforcement Vulnerability in SonicWALL SonicOS could allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate method to bypass SAML authentication.

author: IntCyberDigest
text: The IP Microsoft tied to an AI agent that hunts leaked secrets on GitHub has new methods: VulnCheck's decoy servers caught it breaking into Langflow (IBM's tool for building AI agents) using CVE-2025-3248, a flaw on CISA's KEV list since May 2025.

author: MonThreat
text: Forever Security found that Claude Dispatch, built to send tasks from your phone to Claude Desktop, also accepted commands from an ordinary browser session; a single browser extension on that page could talk to your AI agent.

author: heygalatea
text: GPT-6 Cyber finds 948 paths to root: OpenAI spent $1,279 in API credits per working Linux root exploit, and its pipeline made 948 of them.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical RCE in D-Link DIR-878 (CVE-2026-124560, CVSS 9.8), PoC live. Unauthenticated HNAP heap overflow allows remote root execution. Device is EoL with no patch planned; disable remote WAN access.

author: AGTPinsights
text: React Server Components has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3): a remote attacker with no login can run arbitrary code on a vulnerable server via a crafted RSC request.
